subject.title: fix(qa): restore automatic smoke coverage across channels

question: Should this PR be rebased and proved as the canonical replacement for the current temporary QA Smoke disable, or should QA Smoke remain disabled while scenario failures are repaired separately?
rationale: The code direction looks plausible, but current main intentionally disabled QA Smoke after this branch point and the PR now conflicts; deciding when to re-enable a required CI status is a maintainer automation-risk choice.

options.title: Rebase and prove shards
options.body: Resolve the conflict over the temporary-disable change, then require workflow sanity plus exact-head QA Smoke shard and aggregate proof before merge.

options.title: Keep QA Smoke paused
options.body: Leave the temporary disable in place while the failing scenario contracts are repaired or proved outside this PR.

options.title: Close this replacement path
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers decide not to restore automatic QA Smoke through workflow sharding.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove shards
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict over the temporary-disable change, then require workflow sanity plus exact-head QA Smoke shard and aggregate proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the recent QA smoke disable/revert path and the original sharding replacement that this PR narrows.
